panels.title: Ações auditadas
panels.description: Total de ações registradas no monólito, chat e front no período. Não depende do filtro Serviço; usa os três serviços de auditoria.

targets.expr: sum(count_over_time({container=~"raiji-(app|chat|front)"} |~ "audit_http_request|\"service\":\"front-pwa\"" | json | label_format user="{{.actor_username}}{{.actorUsername}}" | label_format acao="{{if .action}}{{.action}}{{else}}{{.event}}{{end}}" | label_format code="{{.http_status}}{{.status}}" | label_format dur="{{.duration_ms}}{{.durationMs}}" | label_format path="{{.http_path}}{{.path}}" | label_format method="{{.http_method}}{{.method}}" | user=~"$usuario" | acao=~"$acao" | code=~"$status" |~ "$busca" [$__range]))

panels.title: Usuários únicos
panels.description: Pessoas diferentes que fizeram alguma ação no período.

targets.expr: count(count by (user) (count_over_time({container=~"raiji-(app|chat|front)"} |~ "audit_http_request|\"service\":\"front-pwa\"" | json | label_format user="{{.actor_username}}{{.actorUsername}}" | label_format acao="{{if .action}}{{.action}}{{else}}{{.event}}{{end}}" | label_format code="{{.http_status}}{{.status}}" | label_format dur="{{.duration_ms}}{{.durationMs}}" | label_format path="{{.http_path}}{{.path}}" | label_format method="{{.http_method}}{{.method}}" | user=~"$usuario" | acao=~"$acao" | code=~"$status" |~ "$busca" [$__range])))

panels.title: Falhas (4xx/5xx)
panels.description: Ações com erro do usuário (4xx) ou falha do sistema (5xx).

targets.expr: (sum(count_over_time({container=~"raiji-(app|chat|front)"} |~ "audit_http_request|\"service\":\"front-pwa\"" | json | label_format user="{{.actor_username}}{{.actorUsername}}" | label_format acao="{{if .action}}{{.action}}{{else}}{{.event}}{{end}}" | label_format code="{{.http_status}}{{.status}}" | label_format dur="{{.duration_ms}}{{.durationMs}}" | label_format path="{{.http_path}}{{.path}}" | label_format method="{{.http_method}}{{.method}}" | user=~"$usuario" | acao=~"$acao" | code=~"$status" |~ "$busca" | code=~"$status" | code=~"4..|5.." [$__range])) or vector(0))

panels.title: Taxa de erro
panels.description: Percentual de ações que terminaram em 4xx ou 5xx.

targets.expr: (100 * sum(count_over_time({container=~"raiji-(app|chat|front)"} |~ "audit_http_request|\"service\":\"front-pwa\"" | json | label_format user="{{.actor_username}}{{.actorUsername}}" | label_format acao="{{if .action}}{{.action}}{{else}}{{.event}}{{end}}" | label_format code="{{.http_status}}{{.status}}" | label_format dur="{{.duration_ms}}{{.durationMs}}" | label_format path="{{.http_path}}{{.path}}" | label_format method="{{.http_method}}{{.method}}" | user=~"$usuario" | acao=~"$acao" | code=~"$status" |~ "$busca" | code=~"$status" | code=~"4..|5.." [$__range])) / sum(count_over_time({container=~"raiji-(app|chat|front)"} |~ "audit_http_request|\"service\":\"front-pwa\"" | json | label_format user="{{.actor_username}}{{.actorUsername}}" | label_format acao="{{if .action}}{{.action}}{{else}}{{.event}}{{end}}" | label_format code="{{.http_status}}{{.status}}" | label_format dur="{{.duration_ms}}{{.durationMs}}" | label_format path="{{.http_path}}{{.path}}" | label_format method="{{.http_method}}{{.method}}" | user=~"$usuario" | acao=~"$acao" | code=~"$status" |~ "$busca" [$__range]))) or vector(0)

panels.title: Tempo médio de resposta

options.content:
### Como encontrar um acontecimento

- **Serviço**: filtra a busca global (Monólito, Chat, Front, Keycloak, Infra).
- **Usuário**: nome (`maria`) ou `sub` do Keycloak. O padrão `.+` mostra só autenticados; use `.*` para incluir anônimos.
- **Ação**: `RIDE_CREATED`, `MESSAGE_SENT`, `PAYMENT_WEBHOOK` etc.
- **Status**: `2..` sucesso, `4..` falha, `5..` erro, `4..|5..` ambos.
- **Busca**: texto livre, rota ou `request_id` (ex.: `req-123`).
- **Serviço (testes)**: filtra os logs de execução dos testes.
- **Busca SQL**: filtra a tabela `audit_log` (padrão `%`; use `%termo%`).

panels.title: Busca global em todos os logs

targets.expr: {container=~"$servico"} |~ "$busca"

panels.title: Monólito · auditoria HTTP (quem fez o quê)

targets.expr: {container="raiji-app"} |= "audit_http_request" | json | event="http_request" | actor_sub=~"$usuario" or actor_username=~"$usuario" | action=~"$acao" | http_status=~"$status" |~ "$busca" | line_format "{{.actor_username}} | {{.action}} | {{.http_method}} {{.http_path}} | {{.http_status}} | {{.duration_ms}}ms | {{.request_id}}"

{container="raiji-chat"} |= "audit_http_request" | json | audit="true" | actor_sub=~"$usuario" or actor_username=~"$usuario" | action=~"$acao" | http_status=~"$status" |~ "$busca" | line_format "{{.actor_username}} | {{.action}} | {{.http_method}} {{.http_path}} | {{.http_status}} | {{.duration_ms}}ms | {{.request_id}}"

{container="raiji-front"} |= "\"service\":\"front-pwa\"" | json | event=~"http_request|bff_request|page_view" | event=~"$acao" | status=~"$status" | actorSub=~"$usuario" or actorUsername=~"$usuario" |~ "$busca" | line_format "{{.actorUsername}} | {{.event}} | {{.method}} {{.path}} | {{.status}} | {{.requestId}}"
{container="raiji-keycloak"} |~ "LOGIN|LOGOUT" |~ "$busca"

panels.title: Logs dos testes — relatórios de execução

targets.expr: {job="test-logs", service=~"$teste_servico"} |~ "$busca"

targets.rawSql: SELECT created_at AS "Quando", actor_sub AS "Ator", action AS "Ação", entity_type AS "Recurso", entity_id AS "ID", details AS "Detalhes" FROM audit_log WHERE (action ILIKE '%$busca_sql%' OR actor_sub ILIKE '%$busca_sql%' OR details ILIKE '%$busca_sql%') ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 100

targets.expr: {container="raiji-keycloak-events"} |= "keycloak_event" | json | username=~"$usuario" or actorUsername=~"$usuario" or userId=~"$usuario" or actorId=~"$usuario" |~ "$busca" | line_format "{{.username}}{{.actorUsername}} | {{.kind}} | {{.type}} | {{.resourcePath}} | {{.ipAddress}}{{.actorIp}}"
{container=~"raiji-(kong|postgres|rabbitmq)"} |~ "$busca"
